Subject: order entry at Halden

Hi Marcus,

Saw Halden Supply is hiring an order entry clerk to key PDF purchase orders into Dynamics GP. That work tends to grow with every new customer.

We built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business.

Is this on your radar?

Sam
Nextron AI

Not relevant? Reply "no" and I won't contact you again.

Honestly, we'd love to stop re-keying orders from PDFs into GP. Tell me more about how it would work for a team our size.

Marcus
